name: What's the difference between a roof health assessment and a repair quote?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between a roof health assessment and a repair quote?

acceptedAnswer.text: A roof health assessment is a diagnostic service focused on identifying all current and potential issues with your roof, providing an overall condition report. A repair quote, however, is a proposal specifically detailing the cost and scope of work to fix a known problem. The assessment often precedes a repair quote, as it determines what repairs are actually needed. Our assessments prioritize a holistic view of your roof's condition, not just isolated damage, informing more comprehensive solutions.
acceptedAnswer.description: A roof health assessment diagnoses all roof issues, while a repair quote details the cost to fix a specific, known problem; the assessment often informs the quote.
